.._comment_release_type: `simple`, NOT `rust`. The rust strategy reads `package.version`, and this repo's root is a VIRTUAL workspace -- [workspace] + [workspace.package], with no [package] -- so it fails outright with 'value at path package.version is not tagged' and cuts no release PR at all. brain-edge uses `rust` because it is a single crate with a real [package]; that is the difference, not a preference. Known consequence: `simple` has no updater that can reach Cargo.lock, so each release leaves the lock naming the PREVIOUS version and `cargo --locked` fails on main until someone regenerates it. Make that loud with a --locked check in CI rather than trying to make the release strategy fix it.
